briefing: We have a quota to meet. Pirates hold the lane the collective's shipment must cross, and the schedule at {HERE} does not bend for them.
Clear the lane, bring the surveyor in alive, then carry the manifest on to its next hand. Each term stands as stated; meet it, and the contract is fulfilled.
dossier.lead: Word reaches the commander that {PATRON} at {WORLD} wants the lane cleared before the quota slips.

rumour.far: Traders say pirates have shut the lane into {WORLD}, and {PATRON} is hiring a pilot to reopen it.
rumour.near: {PATRON} sends word that the lane to {WORLD} stays closed until a pilot clears it.

dossier.news: At {WORLD}, {PATRON} is recruiting a pilot to break the pirate hold on the shipping lane.
dossier.title: The Vetitice Quota

lane.arrive: Fly the lane to {TARGET} through whatever holds it, and dock
lane.success: The lane is clear, and the shipment moves on for {PAY}
lane.fail: The lane held firm, and {PAY} stays unpaid

pod.arrive: Scoop the surveyor's pod at {TARGET}, and land the passenger alive
pod.success: The surveyor lands alive, and the collective credits {PAY}
pod.fail: The surveyor did not reach dock alive, and {PAY} is void

route.arrive: Bring the surveyor's route back to {TARGET}, and dock
route.success: The route reaches {TARGET}, and the collective pays {PAY}
route.fail: The route never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} is withheld

manifest.arrive: Deliver the manifest to {TARGET}, and close out the contract
manifest.success: The manifest reaches {TARGET}, and the collective settles {PAY} in full
manifest.fail: The manifest never reached {TARGET}, and the collective withholds {PAY}

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander took the collective's contract to break the pirate hold on the lane.

closing.complete: The manifest reached {WORLD} on day {DAY}, and the collective's quota was met.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the contract had collapsed short of {WORLD}, and the collective's quota went unmet.

lane.success: On day {DAY}, the commander broke the pirate hold on the lane and docked at {WORLD}.
lane.failed: By day {DAY}, the lane to {WORLD} stayed closed, and the contract failed.

pod.survivor:landed: On day {DAY}, the commander landed the surveyor alive at {WORLD}.
pod.survivor:sold: By day {DAY}, the surveyor had been sold instead of landed, and the contract failed.
pod.targetDestroyed: On day {DAY}, the surveyor's pod was destroyed before the commander reached {WORLD}.
pod.failed: By day {DAY}, the pod near {WORLD} was never scooped, and the contract failed.

route.success: On day {DAY}, the commander carried the surveyor's route back to {WORLD}.
route.failed: By day {DAY}, the route never reached {WORLD}, and the contract failed.

manifest.success: On day {DAY}, the commander delivered the manifest to {WORLD}.
manifest.failed: By day {DAY}, the manifest never reached {WORLD}, and the contract failed.
